items.title: 33.8 Rules and Regulations regarding Waste Pollution and Conservation (pollution aur bachat ke rules) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.8 (PDF 259); laws as printed, flagged for review.

blocks.text: Government of Punjab (hukoomat-e-Punjab) ne apni jurisdiction (ikhtiyar wale ilaqe) mein pani ki pollution se deal karne ke liye kai acts aur laws (qanoon) banaye hain. Punjab Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab tamam stakeholders (mutalliqa log aur idare) ke liye regular (ba-qaida) rules aur regulations jari karti hai. Neeche table mein EPA Punjab ke water pollution control (pollution par qaboo) aur conservation (pani bachane) se mutalliq ahem rules aur regulations ka overview (khulasa) hai.

blocks.caption: Table 33.3 Key environmental regulations and conservation measures (mahol ke ahem qanoon aur pani bachane ke qadam)
header: Primary Scope and Powers (daira aur ikhtiyar)
Penalties for Non-Compliance (qanoon na maanne par saza)
rows: Rs 5 million tak fine (jurmana), aur saath rozana Rs 100,000 tak additional (izafi) fine.
Pani mein pollutants daalne ya pani ka flow (bahao) rokne par pabandi (prohibition).
3 mahine tak imprisonment (qaid) aur/ya Rs 500,000 fine.
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Pani ke istemal aur drainage (nikasi) ki fees set karta hai; industry aur kheti ki pollution rokne ke liye discharge permits ko control karta hai.
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025

Bare shehron (Lahore, Multan waghera) mein Authority qaim karta hai jo integrated resource management (pani ke zakhiron ka mukammal intezam) aur groundwater conservation (zameen ke neeche ke pani ki hifazat) karti hai.

blocks.title: Maujooda qanoon dekhein
blocks.text: Acts, sazayein aur Did You Know ka jurmana waise hi diye gaye hain jaise kitab mein chhape hain; inhein aaj ke laws se check nahi kiya gaya. Laws aur fines badalte rehte hain; taaza maloomat ke liye EPA Punjab aur sarkari gazette dekhein.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Pakistan Penal Code ke tehat car-washing (gari dhone) ke liye hosepipe (pani ka pipe) istemal karne aur gharon ke lawn ya gardens mein flood irrigation (khula pani chhorna) par Rs 10,000 fine (jurmana) hai.

blocks.prompt: Punjab ka kaun sa act pani mein pollutants daalne ya pani ka bahao rokne se mana karta hai, aur kitab us ki kya penalty (saza) batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Punjab Water Act, 2019; saza 3 mahine tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana.

items: EPA Punjab pani ki pollution par rules aur regulations jari karti hai.
Acts: Environmental Protection Act 1997, Water Act 2019, Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act 2023, Water and Sanitation Authority Act 2025.
